description: This file contains functions that set up mock server expectations for testing OpenAPI specifications using the mockserver-client library. It includes multiple methods for loading OpenAPI specs from URLs, files, classpath, JSON/YAML literals, and updating expectations.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByHttpUrl
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation loading OpenAPI spec from a URL via mockServerClient.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperation
methods.description: Creates a mock expectation for a specific OpenAPI operation using spec URL and operationId.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByFileUrl
methods.description: Loads OpenAPI spec from a file URL and sets up expectation.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByClasspathLocation
methods.description: Loads OpenAPI spec from classpath location string.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByJsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Reads OpenAPI JSON from a file, escapes it, and sets up expectation.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByYamlStringLiteral
methods.description: Loads OpenAPI spec from a YAML string literal and creates expectation.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperationTwice
methods.description: Sets up a repeated expectation for an OpenAPI operation with unlimited times.

methods.name: updateExpectationById
methods.description: Updates an existing expectation by ID with new spec and response.
